meta.name: protocol2_masked_feature_config
meta.description: Protocol 2 features for predicting downstream impact using G - descendants(v). Only local/ancestral and parent-side masked-forward features are included to avoid leakage from graph-wide mask effects.

node_basic.description: Intrinsic node properties available at prediction time (no future info).

parents_degree_stats.description: Statistics of parents within the seen graph.

parents_forward_reach_seen.description: Forward reachability proxies for parents, computed inside seen graph only (no leakage beyond horizon).

parents_ancestry_overlap.description: How similar parents are in upstream lineage (overlap of ancestor sets) inside seen graph only.

parentset_structure.description: Pairwise upstream structure of the parent set.

lineage_fertility.description: How 'fertile' the parents are at the next depth step in the seen graph.

upstream_nonlocal.description: Upstream structure beyond immediate parents (still upstream, but not local).

mixture_diversity.description: How many distinct upstream modules the parents pull from.
